long_biography.plain_text:
Apostolos Kakkos studied physics at the University of Athens, information technology at University College London and industrial relations and management at the London School of Economics. After senior roles in information technology, telecommunications and financial services, he founded Lamda Hellix in 2002 as a joint venture with Lamda Development. He later acquired full ownership and built the company into a regional data-centre operator.

Digital Realty acquired Lamda Hellix in 2020, and Kakkos stayed to guide further expansion before stepping down. He subsequently centred his investment activity on K3 Capital, a family office spanning technology, data centres and real estate. His career therefore joins infrastructure entrepreneurship, a completed corporate exit and continuing stewardship of family capital.
